detail: Step 2 'set its quantity to 0 and submit the update' does not remove the line: the quantity input has min=1 and cart-quantity.js coerces values < 1 to 1, so the line stays at quantity 1 and the 'no line after step 2' expectation fails or engineers improvise. Replace with: click the line's 'Remove' button (aria-label 'Remove Adventurer GPS Watch from your bag').

No kept-for regression case for upheld SOL-1 (pairUiVerify webapp r1): a failed save must keep the stored message under the product name and show an inline error. Observable e2e: save 'Happy birthday, Sam!', open Edit, remove the input's maxlength via DOM, submit 61 chars -> line shows the inline error 'We couldn't save your gift message. Please try again.', still shows "Happy birthday, Sam!" quoted under the name, and the same after reload. The plan instead lists save failure as an open question.

No kept-for regression case for upheld SOL-2 (review r1/r2, review-fix-3 r1/r2): a gift-message post without GiftMessageProductId must show the alert 'Choose an item in your bag to add a gift message to.' above the bag and leave the basket unchanged, including on an empty bag. Observable e2e by removing the hidden GiftMessageProductId input before submitting.
Minor: labelled sad/boundary but is an at-limit happy case; the 60-character save through the API is already proven end to end by TC-GIFT-1-03.

This repeats TC-GIFT-1-14: an omitted protobuf string and an explicit empty string produce the same request value. The prior stored message adds no coverage because the repository is not read. Delete TC-GIFT-1-16; TC-GIFT-1-14 covers empty-value mapping and TC-GIFT-1-05 covers actual clearing across reload.

Successful checkout does not prove the gift message was not sent to Ordering; Ordering could ignore an accidentally forwarded field. Add a focused test using the production order-request serialization that asserts a messaged basket item's outgoing JSON contains no gift-message field.

The case expects 'the page is /cart' after Save. The test calls demo.caption(`After Save: ${page.url()}`), but after Blazor's enhanced form post the Playwright overlay host is gone, so nothing is drawn. Keyframes 06, 07 and 10 have no caption and no URL. Use the in-page caption fallback from bug-44.spec.ts (showUrlAfterPlaceOrder).

The case expects 'after step 4 the page is /cart (no error page)'. The 'After Save' caption draws nothing after the rejected save. Keyframes 11-13 show the inline error and the kept message but no URL.
The case expects 'after step 4 the page is /cart'. The 'After Save' caption draws nothing. Keyframes 10-12 show the notice above the bag but no URL.
The case expects 'after step 4 tab A is on /cart'. The 'Tab A after Save' caption draws nothing. Keyframes 07-10 show the notice above the empty bag but no URL.

The case expects the shopper to be taken to the orders page /user/orders after Place order. The test asserts toHaveURL(ORDERS_PATH) but never captions the URL. Keyframes 09-11 show only the 'My orders' heading, and the recording has no address bar.

After sign-out the 'Signed out' keyframe shows the catalog home page with the leftover caption 'Opened http://localhost:29080/cart', which contradicts the frame. Clear the caption, or set one for the current URL, before the sign-out highlight.

The test asserts /user/orders and the recording shows one $199.99 order, but the post-checkout frames show neither an address bar nor a caption identifying the redirect URL. Add a caption using page.url() before highlighting the order list, then regenerate the recording.
